task.behavior: Template library and diagram walkthrough: the start surface leads with a searchable gallery of editable starter diagrams covering all five kinds, each card drawn from the real document, each use producing an independent copy; and any diagram can be read step by step from a derived order without authoring a story.
acceptance: Every template validates, builds a scene, and has no overlapping components.
All five document kinds and all five categories are represented.
Using a template opens an independent copy with a fresh document id and the template's title, leaving the catalog entry untouched.
An invalid template reports why instead of failing silently.
Template cards are rendered from the template's own document, not from images.
Search matches title, blurb and tags.
A walkthrough derives an ordered step list for every kind, starts a lifecycle at its initial state, and covers every component.
Walking a diagram changes nothing in it, and an authored story takes priority over the derived order.
The editor imports no document from tests/fixtures.
